text:
sara: Quick heads-up: pen-test retest for payment-api (ACME) needs scheduling. Proposed window Tue 2026-04-14 09:00-13:00 PDT. Need owners for RBAC changes, KMS access, audit export, evidence packaging, and a rollback playbook.

matt: I can take oncall + evidence export. Do we have a minimal perms matrix for the assessor?

sara: Minimal perms plan: create ephemeral role assessor_retest with ttl=4h. Permissions: kms:Decrypt on alias/assess-payment, logs:FilterLogEvents for /aws/lambda/payment-api, s3:GetObject for s3://pt-evidence-acme/*, cloudtrail:LookupEvents read-only. No access to prod db or write actions.

olivia: For KMS, prefer granting via our short-lived proxy token (sts:AssumeRole through access-proxy) with an aws:SourceIp condition restricting to assessor VPN. Add a KMS key policy statement that allows aws:PrincipalTag/assessment=true so we can audit easily.

raj: I'll prepare a Terraform module fragment and a smoke test. Example snippet:
```hcl
module "pt_ephemeral_role" {
  source = "git::https://git.redwood/infra/modules/ephemeral-role.git"
  role_name = "assessor_retest"
  ttl_hours = 4
  allowed_actions = ["kms:Decrypt","logs:FilterLogEvents","s3:GetObject"]
}
```
I'll include tags: {assessment=ACME-2026, window=2026-04-14T09:00Z}.

sara: Evidence requirements: 1) CloudTrail export last 14 days (payment-api events), 2) pre-signed s3 bundle with filtered logs and mapping file (STS token id -> principal ARN), 3) live tail link to CloudWatch Logs for duration. Presigned links should be stored in evidence-vault (read-only) and never pasted in public.

matt: I'll run the CloudTrail exporter into s3://pt-exports/acme-2026/ and create presigned URLs with 8h expiry. Will also ensure Splunk/SIEM ingests the same export. ETA 20h.

olivia: Make sure to enable a resource-based policy on the payment log group to prevent log deletions by the assessor. Also bump retention to 30d for this log group and snapshot before test start.

sara: Rollback plan (target <10m): 1) aws sts revoke-session for assessor role 2) detach the ephemeral policy 3) expire/rotate any presigned links via invalidating object or rotating bucket creds 4) rotate assessment KMS key if suspicious. Put exact commands in the runbook.

raj: Draft rollback commands I'll add to repo ops/pt-retest/runbooks/rollback.md:
```bash
# revoke role sessions
aws iam revoke-role-sessions --role-name assessor_retest || true
# remove policy
aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name assessor_retest --policy-arn $POLICY_ARN
# invalidate presigned by rotating the bucket's KMS key policy or replace object
```
Also adding an automated monitor that alerts on kms:Decrypt calls outside the scheduled window.

matt: I'll add product/legal to the reading room invite: @jordan-prod and @maria-legal. Need one product SME on standby to triage false positives.

security-bot: Action required: fill assessment tracker entry: https://tracker.redwood.internal/assessments/ACME-2026 with start_time, end_time, roles_created, kms_key_alias, evidence_bucket, contact_list. Reminder set for 48h before window.

olivia: One more: ensure the mapping file includes both STS session name and token id, plus the IP observed. That makes auditor mapping easier. Also provide a sampled log of the first 1000 filter hits so assessors don't over-query the whole retention during the window.

sara: Owners / ETA: matt = evidence export & SIEM (20h), raj = terraform + runbook (6h), olivia = KMS policy + log RBAC (8h), sara = calendar invite + tracker entry (done). We'll run a dry-run tomorrow 11:00 to exercise assume-role and evidence collection.

matt: PR created: https://git.redwood/ops/pt-retest/pull/58  (includes export job and presigned helper). Requesting review from olivia and raj.

raj: LGTM, will review and verify smoke test.

security-bot: Status recorded: retest window created, artifacts requested, dry-run scheduled. Next reminder in 24h.
